title: What ran: the validated command and how much of its output came back

argv.description: The normalised command that ran (flags rewritten as --name=value; logs get a default --tail and --limit-bytes)

truncated.description: output was cut to maxOutputLines lines (or 1 MiB), or kubectl logs stopped at its 1 MiB byte limit

redactions.description: Credential-looking values replaced by [REDACTED] in output and stderr

stderr.description: What kubectl printed on stderr of a successful run (for example 'No resources found in x namespace.')
